response.sql:
WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM station_averages
)
SELECT s.observstation,
       s.avg_bandusagepct,
       s.avg_bandusagepct - o.avg_bandusagepct AS above_overall_avg
FROM station_averages AS s
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE s.avg_bandusagepct > o.avg_bandusagepct
ORDER BY above_overall_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Stations with no non-NULL telescope bandwidth values are excluded because they have no computable station average.
